text: T7 RNA polymerase is an orthogonal polymerase that transcribes roughly five times faster than native E. coli RNA polymerase, enabling very high expression levels when paired with its cognate promoter.
explanation: This is true: T7 RNA polymerase, when paired with a synthetic sigma factor system, is completely orthogonal to host E. coli transcription machinery and transcribes roughly 5 times faster than native E. coli RNA polymerase, which is why it is widely used to drive very high levels of recombinant gene expression.
